about.title: Let's work together
about.text1: I’m a frontend developer in training, currently focusing on JavaScript, TypeScript and Angular. What drives me is the moment an idea turns into something people actually use. I’ve experienced that firsthand: in a four-person software team I’ve worked on BSTAGE, a platform that connects artists, agencies and event organizers, and I built a staff alert system for the club I help run, replacing unreliable walkie-talkies in a loud environment. I improve my skills by building, by looking at how others solve problems, and by staying curious about new tools. That includes AI, which I use daily to prototype faster, learn faster and question my own solutions. I’m eager to keep learning new technologies and to turn that knowledge into clean, maintainable code.
about.text2: When I face a problem, I start by understanding it properly: What is the actual goal, who uses it, and where does it break? From there I think analytically, break it into small parts and test my assumptions. I stay persistent when the first solution doesn’t work, and I stay creative when the obvious route is a dead end. After each challenge I ask myself whether there is a simpler or more elegant way, and I carry that lesson into the next project. Just as important to me is collaboration: I work best in a team, where discussing ideas and giving and receiving feedback leads to better results than working alone.
about.text3: Beyond the technical side, I bring experience in business leadership. As deputy managing director, I helped build an event company, I lead employees, and I’m well versed in bookkeeping and day-to-day business operations. That helps me think about software not only technically, but also from the perspective of users, budget and team. On top of that comes my creative side: I design branding, visuals and video content, I’m proficient in the Adobe Creative Cloud, and I use AI tools to make ideas visible quickly. This mix of technology, design and entrepreneurial thinking is what I want to bring to a development team.

projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
projects.polloLoco: A jump-and-run game built with object-oriented JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas. Help Pepe cross the desert, collect coins and salsa bottles and defeat the giant boss hen.
projects.pokedex: A Pokédex based on the PokéAPI, designed like the device from the series. Load, search and browse Pokémon and open details with stats and evolution chains.
